title: アカデミックライティング
subtitle: Academic Writing
educationalGoal: Instructors in these courses: (1) Assign short writing exercises or drafts (2) Emphasize revision when necessary (3) Teach the core skills of academic writing in biological and biotechnology disciplines (4) Teach analysis, constructing arguments, and proper citation and use of sources
advice: Instructors in these courses assign short writing exercises or drafts, and in some cases emphasize revision. Instructors teach the core skills of academic writing in biological and biotechnology disciplines, which include analysis, constructing arguments, and proper citation and use of sources. In writing-intensive courses, students will complete multiple writing assignments of varying lengths. One of these writing assignments will be revised, and students will produce a minimum of 10 to 12 pages of writing exclusive of the revisions during the half term course.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of biochemistry, physics and chemistry; high school-level knowledge of biology; and the basics of cell biology.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
